Clinical Pharmacology Basic Principles MasterClass

Follow the channel’s playlist in its published teaching order.

Source YouTube playlist · Order imported from the published playlist.

  1. 1. Clinical Pharmacology Basic Principles Free Course | Introduction
  2. 2. Routes of Drug Administration: Oral, Intravenous, Intramuscular, Intranasal and MORE
  3. 3. Drug Absorption: pKa, First Pass Metabolism, Bioavailability and Mechanisms of Drug Absorption
  4. 4. Drug Distribution: Volume of Distribution, Binding of Drugs to Plasma Proteins and Tissue Proteins
  5. 5. Drug Metabolism: Phase I and Phase II of Hepatic Drug Metabolism
  6. 6. Drug Elimination: Elimination Half Life, First and Zero Order Kinetics, Loading Dose and Clearance
  7. 7. Drug Targets Pharmacology: Receptors, Ion Channels, Enzymes and Carrier Molecules All Explained
  8. 8. Drug Agonist Dose Response Curves, Quantal and Graded Responses and Efficacy VS Potency
  9. 9. Types of Antagonists: Reversible Competitive, Irreversible Competitive and Non Competitive
  10. 10. Drug Factors Affecting Patient Response: Drug Structure, Molecular Weight and Combination
  11. 11. Patient Factors Affecting Response to Drugs: Drug Tolerance, Rebound and Withdrawal Effects
